mapper.sql: select t.teacher_id, t.teacher_code, t.teacher_name, t.dept_id, t.position, t.phone, t.user_id, t.status, t.remark, t.create_by, t.create_time, t.update_by, t.update_time, d.dept_name from talk_teacher t left join sys_dept d on t.dept_id = d.dept_id
mapper.insert: insert into talk_teacher ( teacher_code, teacher_name, dept_id, position, phone, user_id, status, remark, create_by, create_time ) values ( #{teacherCode}, #{teacherName}, #{deptId}, #{position}, #{phone}, #{userId}, #{status}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, sysdate() )
mapper.update: update talk_teacher set user_id = #{userId} where teacher_id = #{teacherId}
mapper.select: select count(1) from talk_teacher where teacher_code = #{teacherCode}
select distinct d.dept_name from sys_dept d where d.dept_type = 'class' and (d.dept_id = #{deptId} or find_in_set(#{deptId}, d.ancestors)) order by d.dept_name
